payload.text: hv, 2026-10-27, directly to vc in vc's session, on ic's hold 17 (the menu's arngz link): 'Ah, now I understand. Yes, of course. And that should be true of all of the ~/bin/* links that are linked to a hardcoded dev install location, rather than using whatever use has set up.' Then, through molt-vc: 'Molt does what it's told and if its a local symlink to a dev checkout in the Molt config, then that's perfectly ok. Molt shouldn't judge that.' So no link outside Molt's config points Utilz at a dev checkout; every tool finds Utilz through utilz use's links or brew's, and a link Molt's config makes into a checkout is the sleeve's choice. vc searched ~/bin (a link to ~/.local/bin), ~/.local, ~/.config, ~/Applications, ~/.local/share, ~/.hammerspoon and the login shell's PATH: ~/.config/menuz/bin/arngz (to the primary's bin/arngz) was the only Utilz one, and no code makes such links (menuz init makes an empty bin/). vc removed it at 09:53:24Z (the bin dir's own mtime; this text first said 09:58Z, which was not read off a clock). The menu's PATH (its bin dir, then the login shell's) now finds /opt/homebrew/bin/arngz (utilz:2.14.4/arngz:1.1.2), and menuz.yaml's arngz items call the bare name. restart.md at 91511a0d.
